tour_name: Oak Bluffs: The Town That Was Built to Be Looked At
description: Eleven stops through the only planned town on the Vineyard — a Methodist tent city that turned into gingerbread, a carousel older than the light bulb, and a beach that turned an insult into an address.
terrain: Flat, paved sidewalks and packed dirt in the Camp Ground; one longer stretch out to East Chop
accessibility: Mostly accessible; the Camp Ground paths are narrow packed dirt, and the East Chop bluff has a gentle grade
season: Late spring through early fall (many sites close in winter)
